summary: Keep composer presentation in the UI kit and connection recovery in the existing workspace footer, without duplicate composer banners.

replay.detail: No claim replay or outbox identity changes.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or data rewrites.

compatibility.detail: Removes app-only composer recovery markup while retaining existing kit submission gates and workspace reconnect controls.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or additional startup work.

manual.detail: No upgrade actions required; existing device pairing and workspace connection controls are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No persistent migration. Offline and revoked drafts remain editable and cannot dispatch automatically.
